standard.title: Halogen Free Flame Retardant (HFFR) Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1 100 Volts — Specification
standard.description: This standard specifies requirements for single-core and multicore halogen-free, flame-retardant, low-smoke (HFFR) insulated and sheathed (if any) electrical cables/cords with rigid or flexible conductors. These cables are designed for use in power and lighting installations in AC single-phase or three-phase systems operating at rated voltages up to and including 1 100 V (1.1 kV) a.c. (50 Hz) or DC systems up to and including 1 500 V to earth.
standard.scope: This standard specifies requirements for single-core and multicore halogen-free, flame-retardant, low-smoke (HFFR) insulated and sheathed (if any) electrical cables/cords with rigid or flexible conductors. These cables are designed for use in power and lighting installations in AC single-phase or three-phase systems operating at rated voltages up to and including 1 100 V (1.1 kV) a.c. (50 Hz) or DC systems up to and including 1 500 V to earth.

amendments.summary: Substitutes references on Page 4 (Clause 5.7) and Page 18 (Annex A, Sl No. 9) to replace 'Annex 4' with 'Annex D' [1]. It completely replaces Annex B, Sl No. 2.2 to update the properties after ageing in an air oven for HFFR sheathing compounds (HFS-TP 70, HFS-TP 90, HFS-XL70, HFS-XL90), specifying aging temperatures and durations (e.g., 80°C for HFS-TP 70, and 100°C for others) [1].

certification.description: Strict Statutory Mandatory Certification. Under the 'Electrical Cables (Quality Control) Order' (Cables QCO 2020) issued by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, all Halogen-Free Flame Retardant (HFFR) cables manufactured, imported, distributed, or sold in India must conform to IS 17048 and bear the mandatory BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Manufacturing, importing, stocking, or selling uncertified HFFR cables is a criminal offense under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable to industrial electrotechnical cables, as it is strictly reserved for gold and silver jewelry under national BIS frameworks.
requirements: Every cable reel or attached label must bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) along with the manufacturer's registered licence number (CM/L).
Conductors must be composed of high-purity annealed bare or tinned copper or aluminium complying with Class 2 (stranded) or Class 5 (flexible) of IS 8130.

Cables are insulated with halogen-free flame-retardant (HFFR) compounds, designated based on material type and rated conductor temperature: a) HFI-TP 70: Thermoplastic HFFR, 70°C maximum; b) HFI-TP 90: Thermoplastic HFFR, 90°C maximum; c) HFI-XL 70: Crosslinked (thermosetting) HFFR, 70°C; d) HFI-XL 90: Crosslinked (thermosetting) HFFR, 90°C.

Sheathing (if any) must be composed of HFFR compounds designated as: a) HFS-TP 70: Thermoplastic HFFR sheathing, 70°C [1]; b) HFS-TP 90: Thermoplastic HFFR sheathing, 90°C [1]; c) HFS-XL 70: Crosslinked HFFR sheathing, 70°C [1]; d) HFS-XL 90: Crosslinked HFFR sheathing, 90°C [1]. Properties after air oven aging are tested as per Amendment No. 1 (80°C for HFS-TP 70 and 100°C for others) [1].

To ensure safety of life and prevent equipment corrosion in fires, cables must meet strict low-smoke and non-toxic emission boundaries: a) Halogen acid gas evolution (measured as HCl) must not exceed a maximum of 0.5 percent by weight; b) Smoke emission must have a minimum of 70 percent light transmittance (negligible smoke opacity); c) Evolved gases must have a pH of minimum 4.3 and a maximum electrical conductivity of 10 µS/mm.

Finished cables must be self-extinguishing and pass mandatory flame tests under IS 10810: a) Flame retardance on single cable (Part 61); b) Flame retardance on bunched cables (Part 62) to prevent rapid fire spread in vertical cable trays.
Insulation and sheathing must undergo tensile strength, elongation at break, hot set, cold bend, and air oven aging tests to ensure long-term physical durability.
